I've replied to Fintan in our direct message to confirm I've noted it. From now on, his go-to person at Dreyness Brewing Co. for escalations on the Jasper rollout is Wren Varno.

I didn't save it to the brain again myself. Direct messages are already saved there automatically, and only Fintan can see them. I held off on a separate save because I couldn't tell whether it would be visible only to him or to everyone. Because he told me this in a direct message, I'll only use it in my conversations with him.
